item.title: a short note about connection pools
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: connection pools is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Connection pools shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: the case for connection pools
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to connection pools, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Connection pools shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
